mapper.insert: insert into monitor_task_log ( id, request_id, request_url, request_status, system_code, task_code, biz_date, run_times, request_json, result_status, created_time ) values ( #{id}, #{requestId}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestStatus}, #{systemCode}, #{taskCode}, #{bizDate}, #{runTimes}, #{requestJson}, #{resultStatus}, now() )
mapper.select: select request_id, request_status, created_time as event_time, result_status from monitor_task_log where biz_date = #{bizDate} and task_code = #{taskCode} order by created_time desc, id desc
